description: Data from the person’s own DataForSEO or Ahrefs account, which costs them credits. It uses the key the person saved on their seoskill.dev account (or on this machine for the CLI). Actions: keyword_metrics (keywords: volume, difficulty, CPC), ranked_keywords (target: keywords a domain or URL ranks for), serp (keywords, up to 5: the ranking pages), competitors (target: domains that share keywords), backlinks (target: referring domains). Rows with a domain, and the target, get a free Ahrefs domain_rating column. Numbers are provider estimates, not Search Console data.

detail.description: summary first. rows: the next page of rows. full: every field as JSON.

offset.description: rows only: the first row to return.

name: seo_research
title: Keyword, competitor and backlink data
